summary: Freedom Metals Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K to report the consummation of its initial public offering of 27,500,000 units at $10.00 per unit, raising $275 million gross proceeds, along with a concurrent private placement of 825,000 units to the sponsor and underwriter representatives. The filing includes an audited balance sheet reflecting the proceeds placed in trust. This is a routine IPO completion disclosure, not a special situation; it merely satisfies listing requirements and provides financial statements.
